The No. 5 Fighting Irish (8-1) vie for their 11th consecutive victory over the Eagles (4-5). Boston College last beat Notre Dame in 2008. Notre Dame held off then-No. 1 Miami, 31-24, last week behind CJ Carr's 319 passing yards and three TD tosses.

John Fanta brings his nonstop energy to the worlds of sports, pop culture, fantasy and betting, alongside Jay Croucher  best of all, the show belongs to the fans, so bring your questions, complaints and wild predictions.
